source.name: Colorlib Bootstrap Templates Ironworks
source.rightsEvidence: The pinned repository template is under MIT. Its retained per-template credits identify the bundled hero photograph as CC0/Public Domain. The license and image credit are included here.

provenance.capture: Pinned local template rendered at 1440px and 390px content widths. Lazy imagery was loaded before capture; the closed navigation drawer was hidden only during the mobile capture to prevent its off-canvas panel from expanding the page width. Visible site content and source markup were unchanged.
provenance.attribution: Colorlib Bootstrap Templates, MIT. Per-template CC0/Public Domain hero photo credit retained; source footer remains visible.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A strength gym is organized as a dark image-led training page with a persistent pale vertical rail and a bold condensed hero promise. Training classes, a weekly timetable, coaches, membership comparison and first-trial form follow in clearly separated operational chapters. Orange labels and actions punctuate the pale rail and dark/gray section surfaces. Timetable, membership prices, trial terms, coach identities, opening hours and gym claims are fictional sample data.

heroGeometry.mode: large athletic typography over a close equipment photograph
heroGeometry.alignment: main content begins to the right of a narrow fixed navigation rail
heroGeometry.viewport: promise and first-session action are clear before schedule information begins

navigationGeometry.placement: left edge with sections, theme control, one action and utility facts
navigationGeometry.mobile: compact top navigation or sheet; do not retain fixed side rail

typography.scale: large uppercase promise, operational labels and dense schedule data with clear hierarchy

palette.ink: near-black or warm white per surface
palette.contrastIntent: strong athletic contrast with orange reserved for active state and action

imageTreatment.mode: monochrome equipment-led hero with restrained portraits
imageTreatment.crop: wide image under overlaid headline; staff images sit in compact coach index
imageTreatment.focalPoint: training equipment supports the promise without obscuring text

servicePresentation.pattern: class index plus schedule table and membership comparison
servicePresentation.interaction: class/time filters only if connected to the true schedule

ctaPlacement.primary: trial or first-session action in the desktop rail and hero
ctaPlacement.early: one clear class/visit action alongside the opening promise

motion.primitive: active section state in the vertical rail and optional schedule filter
motion.library: native scroll state and form controls
motion.reducedMotion: static nav state, complete schedule and visible form

mobileRecomposition.strategy: top utility nav with vertically stacked operations
rules: move action to the opening hero flow
convert schedule into grouped day rows
keep price terms attached to each plan

prohibitedPatterns: copied gym name, headline, data, coach photos or source gym photo
fake availability, capacity, member counts, trial, schedules or prices
unverified health outcomes or transformation results
stock person implied to be coach/member

requiredSignatureElements.description: desktop vertical navigation rail with a compact mobile replacement
equipment-led athletic hero with direct visit action
true weekly schedule, or a clear booking-instructions alternative
plans compared with confirmed inclusions and terms

acceptanceChecks: training offer and real location are immediately understandable
class schedule matches the business's real timetable
membership pricing and terms are client-approved
first-visit form does not collect unnecessary health data
mobile schedule and navigation are usable without sideways scrolling

review.scope: pinned MIT source, CC0 hero image evidence, paired captures and transferable fitness mechanics
